content.short: Global payments platform with vIBANs, stablecoin wallets, pay-ins and payouts.
content.description: Orbital is a UK-based global payments platform that bridges stablecoins and traditional finance for businesses moving money across borders. It gives companies virtual IBANs, stablecoin and fiat wallets, and a crypto payment gateway for accepting pay-ins and sending payouts, letting them collect in local currency and settle in stablecoins such as USDC and USDT over networks including Ethereum, Tron, and Polygon. With compliance and blockchain analytics built in through partners like Chainalysis and Fireblocks, Orbital targets enterprises, marketplaces, and PSPs that want faster, cheaper international settlement than correspondent banking allows. By combining vIBANs, multi-chain stablecoin rails, and fiat off-ramps in one platform, Orbital helps businesses expand into new markets while keeping reconciliation and treasury under control.
content.meta: Orbital bridges stablecoins and banking with vIBANs, pay-ins, and payouts for business. Discover Orbital and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
